patch_description: The crossover partner is a trivial stub, so this proposal keeps the current architecture but strengthens its weakest parts: (1) a corrected deterministic lattice seed producing exactly 11 well-spread points, (2) a faster vectorized area computation reused everywhere, (3) a soft-min pattern search that additionally tries pairwise moves (moving two points simultaneously), which escapes local optima that single-point moves cannot, and (4) a hard refinement that focuses on the point participating in the smallest-area triangle, directly pushing the binding constraint. All steps are deterministic (fixed seeds), with a graceful fallback to the lattice seed on any failure. The result is cached at module load so `heilbronn_triangle11()` returns instantly.
